title: Under ESCAPE and with no array crossed, the flattened name decodes back to exactly the source path
rationale: NameCollisionPolicy.ESCAPE's javadoc claims it is lossless and round-trips. That is an encode/decode claim, the most literal round-trip statement anywhere in the enriched API, and it belongs in a round-trip corpus. This fixture pins the case where the claim holds, and is the passing leg of the DECODED_PATH comparator.
catchesBugClass: A regression that makes the escaped rendering non-decodable - escaping the full separator string instead of its first character, for instance, the exact bug FlattenedPath.appendEscaped's comment records having been caught by a property test.
cannotCatch: Array boundaries, deliberately - see the sibling DEFECT. It cannot check the FAIL policy, where the names are known not to decode; that divergence is already carried by the keyset fixtures and a third row would be redundant.

predicted.detail: decodeSegments of each flattened name equals that leaf's path segment names.

configDescription: assert ENRICHED_METADATA vs DECODED_PATH, collisionPolicy ESCAPE
